criteria.label: Above 50-session average
criteria.definition: Completed daily close strictly exceeds SMA50.

criteria.label: RSI in the selected band
criteria.definition: RSI14 is between 50 and 65, including both endpoints.

criteria.label: Within 5% above 20-session average
criteria.definition: Completed daily close is at least SMA20 and at most 1.05 times SMA20, including both endpoints.

methodology.ranking: Within company stocks and funds separately: more conditions met first; ties use lower ATR14 / completed close, then symbol alphabetically.
methodology.scoreMeaning: A count of three chosen descriptive conditions, not a probability, investment grade, expected return, or validated edge. Thresholds are fixed research choices, not fitted performance claims.
methodology.sourceCutoffMeaning: Completed source daily-session date. Spot may be after hours; independent daily-close availability, full calendar coverage, and corporate-action adjustments are unverified.
methodology.reviewAfterMeaning: Next scheduled U.S. core-session close after this snapshot, from the retained bounded NYSE calendar. A review deadline only; it does not certify new data availability or full historical coverage. Null means no verified deadline was available.

limitations: Ranks cover this small retained universe, not all U.S. stocks. Company stocks and funds are ranked separately.
Recorded daily observations only. Retrieval time does not make a historical price live.
Exchange-calendar completeness, corporate-action adjustment, and independent daily-close availability are unverified. Invalid source prefixes remain excluded and disclosed.
The screen uses price, moving averages, RSI, and ATR only. It does not establish fundamental value, earnings quality, probabilities, future returns, or a buy recommendation.
Undated IV fields, live chart widgets, synthetic grid demonstrations, and brokerage account data are not ranking inputs.
